title: Create a Directory
shortDescription: Develop a directory list of providers that meets your selected criteria
body:
In the Create a Directory module, you can develop a directory list of providers that meets your selected criteria. In the left sidebar navigation panel, click on **Broker Tools** or **Recruitment and Research** and then select **Create a Directory**. The Create a Directory search criteria fields will be displayed.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_1.png)

Search Criteria

 ### Geography Through Create a Directory, you can search providers within a radius of 1-25 miles of one zip code. First, in the Within text box enter the number of miles (from 1 to 25 miles) that you desire the radius to be. Then, enter the specific zip code. ### Network Select one network from the Network dropdown list of available networks.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_2.png)
### Specialties This dropdown list is categorized where the **PROVIDER TYPES** are listed first and then the **SPECIALTY GROUPS** are listed. All are listed in alphabetical order within each category. You can select multiple specialties by clicking on the **PROVIDER TYPES** or the **SPECIALTY GROUPS** name. Once selected, provider types can be distinguished from specialty groups by the inclusion of the **\- Provider Type** descriptor.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_specialities.png)

Results

 After entering your desired search criteria, click **Go**.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_results.png)
The results will appear below the criteria. The results can then be viewed on screen or exported in a .csv file. You’ll see the total number of providers that meet your criteria and a list of the providers including the provider’s name, location, specialty group, and provider type.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_providerlist.png)
Clicking on the blue links within the Create a Directory results will provide more information. For example, clicking on a provider’s name will bring you to the **Provider Details** page. Please refer to the Provider Details Help Content for more information on Provider Details.

Exporting Create a Directory Results

 The Create a Directory results list can be exported as a .csv file. Click the Export button. A message will be displayed to let you know the export process has begun.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_exportinitiated.png)
Once the Export is ready to be downloaded an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to **Download results**.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_exportdownloadresults.png)
Here is an example of the downloaded CSV file which includes Id, NPI, Facility Name, First Name, Last Name, Middle Name and Suffix, Degrees, Group Name, Group Ids, Address ID, Address Confidence, Address including City and State, Zip, Phone Number, Distance (in Miles), Specialty, Specialty Confidence, Specialty Group, Provider Type and Location ID. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/create-a-directory_exportedexcel.png)
